description: This file contains the definition of the 'Blog' controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically handling blog-related functionalities such as displaying blog articles, filtering, pagination, and rendering blog data in the catalog part of the site.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Controller class for managing and displaying blog content within the catalog namespace of OpenCart. Handles loading language files, models, processing request parameters for filtering and sorting, pagination, and preparing data for rendering the blog view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that handles the display of blog articles. Processes request parameters such as search, tag, topic, author, sorting, and pagination. Loads necessary models, retrieves articles and topics, constructs breadcrumbs, sets page metadata, and prepares article data and pagination info for the view.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves article and topic details based on request parameters like article_id or topic_id, sets page metadata, constructs breadcrumbs, and renders the appropriate view for displaying a single blog article or topic. Handles URL parameters for search, tag, author, date, and pagination, and manages error response if the article is not found.
